residentRules: No tax is taken off monthly pay in Hong Kong. Salaries tax is assessed once a year by the Inland Revenue Department on the employee's return: progressive rates of 2%, 6%, 10%, 14% and 17% on net chargeable income in HK$50,000 bands, or the standard rate (15% on the first HK$5,000,000, 16% above) if that is lower. The employer reports pay on form IR56B each year.
